datasets.name: Purpose
datasets.sql:
select p.rowid, 
       p.currency, 
       p.annualinterest,
       p.opendate, 
       p.closedate, 
       p.contractno, 
       p.personaltype,
       p.clienttype, 
       p.branchid,
       a.contractaccid,
       a.interestaccid
from CRA_CONTRACTS P,
     CRA_ACCOUNTS a
where p.id = a.id#
and p.id=:ContID

datasets.name: ContAccs
datasets.sql:
select id,acc_no,name from account 
where Bal_Cn1
       In (
           Select
             AccGroup
            From  SBCM_Acc_Zone_Info
                  Where
                   ZoneID = (
                     Select ZoneID
                       From  SBCM_Acc_Zones
                             Where
                               Upper(Name) = 'DEPOSIT'
                             )
           )

        AND (Close_Dat is null) 
     order by  acc_no

datasets.name: IntAccs
datasets.sql:
select id,acc_no,name from account
where Bal_Cn1
       In (
           Select
             AccGroup
            From  SBCM_Acc_Zone_Info
                  Where
                   ZoneID = (
                     Select ZoneID
                       From  SBCM_Acc_Zones
                             Where
                               Upper(Name) = 'PERCENT'
                             )
           )

        AND (Close_Dat is null) 
     order by  acc_no

datasets.name: Contracts
datasets.sql:
select 
       p.id,
       av.val_name , 
       p.annualinterest,
       p.opendate, 
       p.closedate, 
       p.contractno, 
       cra_contract.CheckContractState(p.id) as status,
       cra_contract.Get_AccountName(a.contractaccid) as accname,
       cra_contract.get_accountnumber(a.contractaccid) as contractaccno,
       cra_contract.get_accountnumber(a.interestaccid) as interestaccno,
       cra_contract.get_accountbalance(a.contractaccid) as ContRest,
       cra_contract.get_accountbalance(a.interestaccid) as IntRest
from CRA_CONTRACTS P,
     CRA_ACCOUNTS a,
     avalute av
where p.id = a.id#
and  p.currency=av.valute
and  p.type#=0
  Order By  Status,:OrderClause
